newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish net forex reserves up to $21.72 bln in May.
newsitem.headline: Polish net forex reserves up to $21.72 bln in May.

text.p: Polish net foreign currency reserves grew by $641 million in May to $21.713 billion but were $298 million lower than a year ago, the National Bank of Poland said on Thursday.
It said net reserves grew $46 million in the January-May period compared to a $1.575 billion rise in the corresponding period of last year.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dollars) MAY APRIL MAY 96
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
